race.verdict: KING CALIFET has few miles on the clock but was most progressive last season and can make a successful return. Tapley has made a fine start for this yard this autumn and may prove the main danger. KING CALIFET (IRE) TAPLEY FIERCE WARRIOR (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Tapley (7/4), El Rio (5/2), King Califet (7/2), Glynn Brae (7/1), Fierce Warrior (8/1)
